# Atlantis Press

> > Atlantis Press is an open-access academic publisher specializing in peer-reviewed journals, conference proceedings, and books, now part of the Springer Nature portfolio.

Atlantis Press operates as a global scholarly publisher with offices in Paris and partnerships across leading academic institutions. The platform provides open-access publishing services across multiple scientific disciplines with strong emphasis on peer-review standards and publication ethics.

## Core Publishing Platforms

- [Journals](https://www.atlantis-press.com/journals): Atlantis Press open-access journals directory and peer-reviewed journal portfolio
- [Proceedings](https://www.atlantis-press.com/proceedings): Atlantis Press proceedings publication platform with open-access conference proceedings
- [Books](https://www.atlantis-press.com/books): Atlantis Press academic book publishing with Springer partnership
